what: A one-line body edit of hello-world allocates and frees about 95 MiB of the global heap: `CompiledFunction::clone` 27 MiB, the linker's `file::fill` 20, `Build::patch_lists` 13, `beside::DebugWrite::apply` 8, `codegen::debug_side` 7.5 (alloc_samples by site, eight edits). The warm loop is meant to allocate nothing there (docs/v2/plan/design/memory.md).
cost: it is why mimalloc on base pages is 17% slower an edit (each build takes the freed pages again a 4 KiB fault at a time), so it is what keeps 1.0 GiB of huge-page slack on every Linux daemon; and it is edit time on any pages
cause: the edit's link and the walk copy whole-program tables
